name: SME Centre HQ Meeting Minutes
description: Weekly HQ team meeting minutes for SME Centre@SMF. Smaller meeting focused on individual BA progress, BAS ground sentiment, GBU updates, BCE event tracking, training hours, and customer feedback. More discussion-based than the Division Meeting format.

sections.title: Meeting Header
sections.instruction: Record the meeting title, date, and time at the top of the minutes.
sections.item_format: Minutes of Meeting for SME Centre HQ Meeting held on [Day], [Date] at [Time]

sections.title: Staff Present
sections.instruction: List all HQ staff present with their initials, name, and designation.

sections.title: Staff Absent
sections.instruction: List any HQ staff who are absent.

sections.title: Business Advisory Session (BAS) Updates
sections.instruction: Record BAS challenges, interesting observations, SME ground sentiment, and any budget measure or policy implications discussed. Include discussion on new government support packages, grants, or schemes relevant to SMEs.

sections.title: Group Based Upgrading (GBU) Updates
sections.instruction: Record individual BA progress on GBU targets, toolkit completion status, SME reception feedback, and any challenges faced. Include discussion on toolkit value, industry-specific gaps, and potential new GBU proposals.
sections.item_format: [BA Name/Team]: [Progress update, challenges, and action items]

sections.title: Business Community Engagement (BCE) Updates
sections.instruction: Record BCE event progress, attendance trends, event feedback, and committed upcoming events. Include discussion on event fatigue, topic relevance, and strategies to improve attendance.

sections.title: Training Updates
sections.instruction: Record individual BA training hour statuses, course registrations, withdrawals, and projections. Note the overall target (80 hours) and any Enterprise Singapore training planned.

sections.title: Customer Feedback & CSS
sections.instruction: Record participant feedback from recent events, Customer Satisfaction Survey (CSS) results, and any issues raised. Include discussion on neutral ratings, PDPA constraints, and follow-up actions.

sections.title: Any Other Business (AOB)
sections.instruction: Record any other business items not covered above.

sections.title: Meeting Close
sections.instruction: Record the names of the minute-taker and approver.
sections.item_format: Recorded by: [Name] Date: [Date]. Approved by: [Name] Date: [Date].
